data.author: Map
data.comment:
## Root cause

The drag gesture never engaged because the boot flow was showing the blocking **New Game mode selector** (MS-0MUTU8INS009MRR1) on top of the scene. The suite seeds the tutorial state as `skipped`, so the tutorial offer is answered and the boot flow proceeds to the New Game selector, whose full-screen backdrop is `setInteractive()`. Every synthetic `mousedown`/`mousemove` dispatched at the market row was hit-tested to that backdrop instead of the upgrade card, so Phaser's drag state never left `0` and `beginDrag` exhausted its 30 s deadline:

```
Timed out waiting for the drag to engage after 30000ms (container.x=328, container.y=136)
```

Diagnosed by logging the Phaser input state after `mousedown`: `_temp` (hit-test result) contained a single unnamed `Rectangle` at depth 200, 1280x720 instead of the container at `_list[47]`. Hiding the selector made `_dragState` go `2 -> 4` and the container follow the pointer.

## Secondary issue: the resume overlay / wedged boot flow

The suite originally only cleared `localStorage`, so a run checkpoint saved by an earlier test in the same file (IndexedDB is origin-scoped and shared) was offered to the next boot as the blocking resume overlay. An earlier attempt to fix that by deleting the `save-load-store` IndexedDB database directly wedged the store's open connection: `_campaignLoadPromise` never resolved, so the boot flow never reached its modal decision (and the `New Game` selector never appeared).

## Fix (test-only)

1. New shared helper `tests/main-street/helpers/bootModals.ts` — `dismissBootModals(scene)` polls for the New Game selector, marks `newGameSelectionMade = true` and hides it. Returns without dismissing when no modal is due (replay/resume boot).
2. `upgrade-drag-drop.browser.test.ts` — call `dismissBootModals` in `bootGame`; clear the run checkpoint through the live store (`scene.saveStore.clear()`) in `afterEach` instead of deleting the IndexedDB database.
3. `drag.browser.test.ts` — same fix; this also clears MS-0MV1HAOC8006SCON (its failing test `drag onto an empty slot buys and places in one undoable step` had the identical root cause and now passes).

## Verification

`npx vitest run --project browser tests/main-street/upgrade-drag-drop.browser.test.ts tests/main-street/drag.browser.test.ts` — **11 passed (11)**. Repeated runs are green. `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. No production code changed.
